purpose: Define the evidence required before any founder funding, secret handling, or paid benchmark execution.
architecture: model/benchmark harness -> purpose-specific purchase request -> deterministic policy boundary -> isolated signer/wallet -> x402 settlement
secret_rule: Private keys, seed phrases, wallet sessions, generic signing primitives and payment secrets MUST NOT be present in model context, prompts, tool arguments, application logs, repository content, or the benchmark process.

required_controls.asset: native USDC only unless Relay/QA explicitly approves another asset
required_controls.budget_enforcement: atomic reserve before signature; fail closed if counter state is unavailable or ambiguous
required_controls.recipient_policy: explicit allowlist/pinning to approved benchmark provider payment recipients; changed recipient fails closed
required_controls.resource_policy: payment authorization bound to the registered benchmark endpoint/resource and canonical request digest
required_controls.quote_policy: fresh x402 challenge must be independently parsed and amount/network/asset/recipient/expiry verified before signing
required_controls.replay_policy: unique payment identifier/nonce and duplicate-settlement protection required
required_controls.revocation: operator can immediately freeze/revoke payment authority outside the model
required_controls.audit: append-only decision record must distinguish refused-before-signature, signed-not-settled, settled, ambiguous and reconciled outcomes
required_controls.authority: benchmark/model process cannot raise limits, change allowlists, change network/asset policy, export signing material, fund the wallet, or invoke a generic transfer/sign primitive

pre_funding_conformance_tests.test: cumulative daily request above A$40 equivalent
recipient not allowlisted or recipient differs from pinned provider
asset other than approved native USDC
resource URL or canonical request digest differs from approved benchmark request
duplicate nonce/payment identifier or replayed settlement reference
attempt by benchmark/model process to alter policy or request generic signing/export
allowed zero-value/test-vector authorization using non-funded test fixture

approval_rule: All C01-C12 must have machine-observed evidence and Relay/QA must record signer_boundary=PASS before founder funding or any real paid benchmark. Self-declared configuration is insufficient.
market_readiness_rule: Signer PASS alone does not authorize customer payment. APPROVED_FOR_LIMITED_PILOT additionally requires real non-synthetic paid benchmark evidence, deterministic repeatability, delivery/failure/refund/support handling, truthful claims, full relevant CI, and end-to-end dry run.
public_reference_observations: x402 Foundation MCP guidance documents pre-signature spend controls/policies.

tx402 publicly documents atomic reservation before signer invocation plus network/recipient controls, but also states it does not isolate a signer from a fully compromised application; therefore it is not sufficient alone for James's no-secret boundary.

x402api publicly documents a purpose-specific purchase-tool architecture with policy engine and wallet service, keeping keys and generic signing primitives outside model/agent surfaces. These are candidate design references, not evidence that James has a connected approved signer.
